description: Affordable housing is a real need, but so is making sure growth doesn’t overwhelm the place you call home. Newtown families know that good planning matters, because when housing, traffic, schools, and infrastructure aren’t handled well, everyone feels it. Michelle wants a smarter approach that supports working families and protects what makes our community special.
paid_for_by: Paid for by the Ku Is For You Committee
title: Affordable Housing is a Real Need - Michelle Embree Ku for Newtown!
